title: Maria GP Possible NDE 5378
content: I had been in pain for many hours and could not achieve dilation. I was an'sthetized for a c'sarean section and went to sleep straightaway. The next thing I remember, there was a being welcoming me. I could not see his face clearly but I knew he was very familiar to me. He was saying something like ‘Here you are! I've been expecting you’. It was a communication in the mind. The being stayed behind while I floated on, being pulled along by a wonderful river of lights. The river took a right turn, and I was in front of two enormous screens, depicting rounded forms made of constantly moving lights and colors. I stood before them, feeling that I was required to understand the movement of those lights. It was similar to needing to figure out a password. Leaving the screens behind, I found myself in darkness. At this point, the feeling of wisdom was enormous, and my heart was overflowing with love. I remembered Jesus, as if I were He. I turned towards the left, and there, at the end of a sort of tunnel, I saw a shining sphere. It spoke to me telepathically (I guess,) and said ‘Not yet, you have to return and guide your family’. Then the light became dimmer and a reddish color. I saw what looked like two three-dimensional busts drawing near. I recognized the faces on the busts as they passed next to me, as one seemed to be of me, and the other my husband. I put myself inside the one that was of me. I don't know how long this lasted, but that is the last I remember of my experience. I awoke feeling very cold, but at no point was this because I was afraid as I was in my own home. After all these years, I still feel that coldness inside me, just as I have it while writing this.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A "wonderful river of lights" that took a right turn; later "a sort of tunnel" with a shining sphere at the end.

arrival.other_being_detail: A familiar male being welcomed her; face not clearly seen; communicated in the mind: “Here you are! I've been expecting you”.

environment.environment_other_detail: Two enormous screens depicting rounded forms made of constantly moving lights and colors; later darkness; a shining sphere at the end of a tunnel; light became dimmer and reddish.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Saw two three-dimensional busts drawing near (one seemed to be of her and the other her husband); she put herself inside the one that was of her.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: “Not yet, you have to return and guide your family”.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Anesthetized for a C-section after many hours in pain and no dilation.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two enormous screens of moving lights/colors; later darkness; two 3D busts (herself and husband) as part of return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Welcoming being → river of lights → screens → darkness/expanded wisdom and love → tunnel with shining sphere → told to return → re-entry via 3D busts.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Two enormous screens with rounded forms of constantly moving lights/colors that she felt required to understand (like a password); return involved two three-dimensional busts (herself and husband) and putting herself into her own bust.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Here you are! I've been expecting you”. “Not yet, you have to return and guide your family”.
